title: Briefing attendees rebuild the Aquarius briefing from memory in a motel

tellings.quote: They the guys of the in the briefing got together afterwards, went to a motel and they basically wrote down from memory uh what they recalled about the briefing

plain: In 1977, the people who sat in on a secret briefing about Project Aquarius, said to be a classified government UFO program, are said to have gone to a motel afterwards and written down from memory everything they could recall of it. Eric W. Davis, a scientist who has worked with the Pentagon, tells Michels this as he heard it, citing a man named Alonzo McDonald and the UFO researcher Bill Moore, and he ties it to the written Aquarius briefing document, which on this account would be a reconstruction of a real briefing.
